infer: ranks and signs¶

Tests that use ranks or signs: the rank-sum, signed-rank and sign tests. Each page documents one function: its signature, what it computes, the parameters, the fields of the result, the errors, and examples with their output.

The Surface¶

Function

What it does

ranksum

Wilcoxon rank-sum (Mann–Whitney) test for two independent samples.

signrank

Wilcoxon signed-rank test for a median or for paired differences.

signtest

Sign test for a median or for paired differences.
